# Packages Clave talks to directly (PROJECT_PLAN.md COMP-5). When one of
# them changes upstream, .github/workflows/upstream.yml runs the lint and
# install jobs of ci.yml. The pacman hook (COMP-9) and clave-doctor (COMP-8)
# check the same list against compat.json.
#
# Format: SOURCE NAME [URL]
#   repo  an Arch repository package (pacman -Si)
#   aur   an AUR package (AUR RPC)
#   git   a git repository Clave downloads from (git ls-remote)

# Compositor and its tools
repo hyprland
repo hyprlock
repo hypridle
repo hyprsunset
repo xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
git hyprland-plugins https://github.com/hyprwm/hyprland-plugins

# Shell
repo quickshell
repo qt6-declarative
repo swaync
repo swayosd
repo rofi

# Login and boot
repo sddm
repo plymouth
repo cryptsetup

# Theme
repo gtk4
repo libadwaita
aur whitesur-icon-theme
aur kvantum-theme-whitesur-git
git WhiteSur-gtk-theme https://github.com/vinceliuice/WhiteSur-gtk-theme

# Engines behind Clave's own tools (SHELL-1, APP-8)
repo grim
repo slurp
repo wf-recorder
repo satty
repo python-icalendar
repo python-vobject
